Per docs/scope.md ('Cell line, PDX, and organoid meningioma omics data (in vitro/model systems, not patient tissue directly)' is adjacent, not core), routed here rather than into /data/. tissue_preservation set to 'not_applicable' and anatomic_location_breakdown/treatment_timepoint_status set to 'Not applicable', since these are in vitro cultures, not directly-sampled patient tissue with a preservation method or anatomic site of its own. paired_multimodal.is_paired left false for the same reason as the tissue-arm record: both arms are the same modality (bulk_rna_seq), so this doesn't meet multi_modal_matched's >=2-modality definition even though it's a genuine matched cohort; the relationship is carried via related_datasets only.
